description: Extract a page's structured data into a named schema's common fields (no LLM): article, product, event, faq, recipe, course, organization, local_business, breadcrumb, dataset or job_posting. When to use: you need fields (title/author/date, price/currency/availability, event dates, FAQ Q&A, recipe ingredients, org address) rather than raw markdown or tables. Do not use: to get every JSON-LD block verbatim (web_metadata/web_extract) or to read text (web_fetch). Returns: {ok, url, final_url, schema, requested_schema, detected_types, matched, fields:{...}, sources:[jsonld|meta], jsonld_count, tables_count, took_ms, cached, _metering}. If no matching JSON-LD exists it falls back to Open Graph/meta fields and matched=false. Metered: shares the web free bucket (100 calls/day per IP), then 1 credit per call over x402.

schema.description: Target schema; auto detects from JSON-LD types. Default auto.
